part.Name: Description
part.Short: Chrome casing holds the wisp of a thin world line cook trained to the perfect realization of a single dish. The sac of synthmeat beneath is pantry, kitchen, and serving tray in a meticulous braid.

part.Name: CyberneticsBaseItem
part.BehaviorDescription: You are able to imprint a single metabolized meal effect into the sac, rendering it permanently active.
